stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the telemetry data. Cleaned and merged the site historian and field operations datasets, handling data anomalies. Generated visualizations for daily total energy production, unit-specific production, and discrepancy distributions. Wrote a comprehensive quarterly operational performance report (report/report.md) detailing methodology, results, data integrity findings, and actionable recommendations for management.
